referenceMethod: Horizontal position at four outer Aula eave corners in the independent 3DBAG BAG building polygon (NL.IMBAG.Pand.0503100000019275). AHN 0.5 m DSM samples within 2.4 m, retaining heights between 8 and 14.5 m NAP; use 85th percentile of those roof returns to reduce mixed wall/ground edges. Local (X,Y,Z) = (RD easting - 85454, NAP height + 0.6969, 446477 - RD northing), metres. Ground origin uses the AHN DTM cell containing the specified RD position.
scaleBasis: The original photogrammetric point cloud has arbitrary units. Fit one positive uniform scale to three spatially separated metric references from the Dutch independent mapping and airborne laser data.
toleranceBasis: Before fitting, allow 1.00 m for site visualization from 0.5 m laser raster, map outline and optical eave localization. Reference uncertainty is an engineering estimate of 0.60 m, not a certified survey precision. Require every anchor, including the withheld corner, to meet the gate. No mechanical clearance or site collision claims.
